name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
title: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd - 543514 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Education company (not a capital-cycle business) posts FY26 PAT of INR 130 crores vs loss of INR 252 crores, with FY27 guidance of INR 670 crores revenue and INR 144 crores PAT; capacity build-out is opex-led and the commerce demerger is pending.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue ~INR 670 cr, PAT >INR 144 cr

triggers.label: Commerce demerger, listing by end-July/mid-Aug
triggers.quote: we expect it to be listed by end of July or by mid-August

triggers.label: 15 new B.Com colleges; FY27 EBITDA dip
